title: DPP data point
description: A data point that a legal act requires, allows or expects in a digital product passport. Data points are reference material for criteria; they are not checked themselves.

regime.description: Legal act that defines the data point.

tier.description: How firmly the legal act fixes the data point. ESPR: fixed, minimum, conditional, delegated-act, annex-i, voluntary. Product-specific acts (TOY, CPR, BATT): regime. Law outside DPP rules: sectoral.

term.description: Term used in the English version of the legal act.

en18223_attribute.description: Attribute of the class DigitalProductPassport (EN 18223:2026, Table 1) that carries the value, if any.

granularity.description: Level the value refers to (model, batch, item, product type, substance, ...).

access.description: public: the legal act puts the value in the public part, or requires it on the product or via the data carrier without access restriction. restricted: the legal act limits it to named actors. delegated-act: left to the delegated or implementing act. unspecified: the legal act says nothing about access.

battery_applicability.description: Only for regime BATT: whether the data point is to be provided for each battery category with a battery passport (Regulation (EU) 2023/1542, Art. 77(1)).

industrial.description: Industrial batteries with a capacity greater than 2 kWh.

semantic_ids.description: Identifiers of concepts in open dictionaries that denote this data point, so that passports built on those dictionaries (for example Asset Administration Shell submodels) can be matched to it. Only identifiers: no names or definitions from the dictionaries. Each entry is taken from a published document that ties the identifier to a clause of the legal act in basis or to the EN 18223 attribute in en18223_attribute.

status.description: mandatory: to be provided. optional: to be provided if the information is available. if-applicable: to be provided where the condition in note applies. not-to-be-filled: not to be provided or displayed, see reason.

reason.description: Why the data point is not to be provided. repetition: the same information is already provided under the data points in same_as. pending-implementing-act / pending-delegated-act: the act that specifies the information has not been adopted. applies-later: the information is required from applies_from. on-hold: the guidance has set the data point aside. not-for-category: the data point does not apply to this battery category.

same_as.description: With reason repetition: the data points that already carry the information.

applies_from.description: Date from which the data point is required, where the legal act or the guidance names one: YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM if only the month is named.

scheme.description: Dictionary that issues the identifier. idta-cds: concept descriptions published by the IDTA in its submodel templates (https://admin-shell.io/idta/... or urn:samm:io.admin-shell.idta...). iec-cdd: IRDI of the IEC Common Data Dictionary (IEC 61360). eclass: reserved; not accepted until publishing ECLASS identifiers in this repository is cleared.

relation.description: same-as: the identifier denotes the same information as the data point. is-case-of: the source declares the concept of the data point a case of the concept the identifier denotes (isCaseOf of a concept description in the Asset Administration Shell); that concept can be more general or the same concept in another dictionary or model.

source.description: Document and version the identifier and its relation to the data point are taken from.

allOf.$comment: ECLASS identifiers are reserved in the scheme list but rejected until their publication is cleared.
